elements.label: text

elements.char: data from [2]. A typical scratch assay involves (i) growing a cell monolayer up to some desired
elements.label: text

elements.char: initial cell density, (ii) creating a “scratch” in the interior of the monolayer to produce an
elements.label: text

elements.char: empty region, and (iii) recording longitudinal measurements of the cell density during re-colo-
elements.label: text
